text: Natural Language Processing (NLP) is a type of technology that helps computers understand human language. One key part of NLP is text understanding, which allows machines to read and make sense of what people write. Translation is another useful application. With NLP, computers can translate words and sentences from one language into another quickly and accurately. Sentiment analysis is also important because it helps computers recognize whether a piece of text is positive, negative, or neutral. This is very useful for understanding customer opinions. Finally, chatbots use NLP to communicate with people in a natural way, answering questions and giving helpful information. Thanks to NLP, our interaction with technology is becoming easier and more human.
